note: The user's disclosure policy. answerers are the outside parties a pour may go to; any other is refused. Every pour to them needs the user's approval of the exact payload, unless the user made a standing policy for it with `abalone approvals --standing` (stored in <ABALONE_DIR>/approvals/standing.json; abalone ships none). mediator is the private model that reads first when an outside model is selected. Canaries always block: folder canaries come from `abalone canary init <folder>`; canaries and canary_files here are extra ones.
